text.en: Reloading after defeating a target causes the next burst to be a longer, more powerful superburst.

Finishing a reload within 3.6? seconds of a kill grants 'Unrepentant' for 10 seconds. Buff is removed on stow. 

Unrepentant fires an extended 6-round burst that deals <pve 200% /> <pvp [0%] /> increased damage.
